cross_branch_pointers.rule: An evidence row may cite a sealed artifact from another branch/commit ONLY if that commit is listed in SOURCE_LOCK.json trace_pointers with exact path and artifact digest, and the row records impact_disposition RETAINED_AFTER_IMPACT_ADJUDICATION with a predicate. Any other cross-branch pointer (unmerged sibling state, unpublished local runs, post-lock drift) evaluates the row to UNKNOWN with reason CROSS_BRANCH_UNSEALED. WS222/WS223/WS224 unpublished state is never consumed.

requires: RSP 1.1 handshake runtime under current manifest
declared production topology (absent until provider selection)
per-candidate topology proof at declared topology
sealed domain-freshness artifact (CR/Oracle/Commander-B&R + deck legality + opponent provenance)
G01.stale_rule: A historical FAIL stays current (still FAIL) while WS220 F-QUAL-02 holds (no sealed freshness artifact exists); it is NOT re-verified, it is re-confirmed absent.

G13.computed: FAIL unless every G00-G12 verdict is PASS; NOT_APPLICABLE never satisfies G13.
requires: generator rollup only; no independent evidence
active frozen campaign contract for NOT_RUN; absent contract yields NOT_APPLICABLE (non-blocking only via G13 FAIL)
holdout-enabled contract for PASS; otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE (optional gate)

fixture_row_rules.duplicate_conflict: Two different verdicts for one (candidate, fixture) with no adjudication record => row UNKNOWN, reason DUPLICATE_CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE. (Prevented by construction: overrides keyed by fixture_id; enforced by test.)
fixture_row_rules.missing_row: A mandatory fixture with no row at all => row NOT_RUN, reason MISSING_FIXTURE_ROW. (Prevented by construction: generator emits the full 135 denominator per candidate; enforced by test.)
fixture_row_rules.pass_requires: verdict PASS is kept ONLY if evidence_class is RUNTIME_VERIFIED AND current is true AND provenance resolves AND (source lock matches candidate pin OR impact_disposition is RETAINED_AFTER_IMPACT_ADJUDICATION with predicate). Otherwise the row becomes UNKNOWN (weak class preserved in evidence_class for diagnosis).
rejected_to_unknown: PASS verdict unsupported by required runtime evidence
legacy free prose without explicit mapping where mapping is required
stale source lock without retention predicate
cross-branch pointer outside SOURCE_LOCK trace pointers
retained_row_requires: predicate: engine pin unchanged + mutation-surface diff clean (recorded)
rerun_pointer or machine predicate reference (S8-future compatible)
player_count_scope where the evidence is count-specific
fixture_row_rules.stale_rule: A row whose artifact commit/tree differs from the candidate pin AND carries no retention predicate => UNKNOWN, current=false, reason STALE_SOURCE_LOCK. A historical PASS NEVER survives a material source change without adjudication.

gate_rollup.blocked_flag: blocked=true iff verdict != PASS and the determining items carry failure classification AUTHORITY_BLOCKED or omission PROTOCOL_ADAPTER_MISSING / REMEDIATION_REQUIRED / RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE. BLOCKED is a display flag, never a verdict: the verdict stays in the 7-term vocabulary.
invalid_rollups: one strong fixture compensates for one missing mandatory fixture
candidate README claim fills an evidence hole
historical PASS survives material source change without adjudication

special.all_not_applicable: Gate verdict NOT_APPLICABLE only if EVERY mandatory item is NOT_APPLICABLE (G14/G15 shape). A required gate with NOT_APPLICABLE still blocks G13.
special.pass_condition: Gate verdict PASS iff EVERY mandatory item has verdict PASS with acceptable evidence class and current=true. One mandatory UNKNOWN/NOT_RUN/PARTIAL/FAIL poisons the gate per priority above.

generator_authority: Canonical contracts plus sealed evidence remain the ONLY authority. The generator is a deterministic view: if the view and source disagree, the generator/test FAILS. The view never overrides source. Disagreement procedure: FAIL the WS225 validation gate, fix the mapping layer, regenerate.

retention_future_s8.format: Future retained evidence MUST point to either {machine_predicate: <named predicate + evaluation record>} or {rerun_pointer: <exact run/artifact pointer>} plus player_count_scope where the claim is count-specific. Prose-only retention (WS220 F-EVID-04a class) is rejected at the join.
retention_future_s8.not_executed: WS225 does not execute S8; this format only keeps the trace model retention-compatible.

vocabulary.satisfying_pair: verdict PASS AND evidence_class RUNTIME_VERIFIED (is_satisfying_evidence). No other pair grants behavior credit.
